status.summary: Unbeaten Ecuadorian welterweight (pro 19-0, UFC 7-0) coming off first-round TKOs of Gilbert Burns (May 17, 2025) and Sean Brady (UFC 322, Nov 15, 2025). He was the backup fighter for the UFC 330 title fight (Aug 15, 2026). After Islam Makhachev backed out of UFC 336, the UFC announced at UFC 333 (Oct 24, 2026) that Morales faces Carlos Prates for the interim UFC welterweight title in the co-main event (Jan 30, 2027, Scotiabank Arena, Toronto). He has said he walks around 220 lb, about 50 lb above the limit, as he starts the camp. No injury reported.
status.ranking: #3 welterweight in both the UFC media rankings (Nov 3, 2026) and the Meta UFC rankings (Oct 31, 2026), per ufc.com (Nov 4 Wayback capture); CBS Sports and EventClock also had him #3 (Nov 2026).
status.next_fight: vs Carlos Prates for the interim UFC welterweight title, UFC 336 co-main event, Jan 30, 2027, Scotiabank Arena, Toronto (announced Oct 24, 2026)

style.summary: A big, long welterweight who boxes behind a stiff jab and lands a heavy right hand. He knocks opponents down at roughly three times the league rate and has never been knocked down. He keeps fights standing (88% takedown defense) and finishes hurt opponents with ground strikes. His last three opponents (Magny, Burns, Brady) were all stopped in round 1.

moves.notes: Weights follow his target split in fighters.json. Decayed significant attempts go 87.0% head, 4.4% body, 8.6% legs; landed strikes go 81.7% head, 5.8% body, 12.6% legs. Punches to the head dominate, and every body option stays at 0.05. 77% of landed strikes come at distance, the rest mostly ground strikes in finishes, so knees and elbows are near zero. Leg kicks get 0.15 each, matching his 8-12% leg share, with heavier use in decisions (27/34 vs Matthews). Weighting the jab and right hand highest is a judgment from his reach and the distance-punch finishes of Burns and Brady recorded in ufcstats. Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight totals.
